project.name: VNShop
project.description: Multi-seller Vietnamese retail marketplace for buyer discovery, seller commerce, checkout, fulfillment, payments, and marketplace operations.

nodes.name: Identity and Marketplace Access
nodes.summary: Manages buyer, seller, and administrator identity, sessions, roles, profiles, and seller onboarding. It controls which marketplace capabilities each persona can access.

businessRules: Protected routes require an authenticated session
Role guards restrict administrative and seller operations
crossDomainInteractions: Provides actor identity to catalog, order, payment, and administration flows

nodes.name: Catalog and Product Discovery
nodes.summary: Maintains marketplace categories and seller product listings, and exposes product browsing, search, facets, recommendations, flash sales, wishlists, and product media.

businessRules: Only active catalog products are returned for normal seller product lists
Product variants are selected by SKU
crossDomainInteractions: Provides purchasable products to cart and checkout

nodes.name: Order and Fulfillment
nodes.summary: Turns a buyer cart into an order, coordinates multi-seller order state, and supports seller acceptance, shipping, delivery, cancellation, and returns.

businessRules: Checkout captures shipping information and selected payment provider
Seller order actions advance fulfillment state
Returns identify a sub-order and may select an item and pickup mode
crossDomainInteractions: Triggers notifications and seller finance updates

nodes.name: Payments and Marketplace Settlement
nodes.summary: Initializes and confirms buyer payments across supported providers, handles payment return and recovery, and exposes seller wallets and administrator payout decisions.

businessRules: Checkout supports COD and online providers such as VietQR, Stripe, and PayPal
Payment return state must be reconciled with the owning order
crossDomainInteractions: Feeds administrator revenue and payout queues

nodes.name: Trust, Engagement, and Marketplace Operations
nodes.summary: Supports reviews, questions, notifications, messaging, video moderation, coupons, disputes, and operational dashboards that close the marketplace feedback loop.

businessRules: Reviews and video content can enter moderation queues
Notifications are delivered through persisted and socket-based channels
Administrative queues govern disputes, reviews, payouts, sellers, and videos
crossDomainInteractions: Consumes order completion and catalog content

nodes.name: Authenticate and Manage Account
nodes.summary: Registers or signs in a marketplace user, maintains the authenticated session, and manages profile and address information.

nodes.name: Submit credentials
nodes.summary: Accepts registration or login credentials from the buyer or seller.

nodes.name: Establish session
nodes.summary: Stores the live token set and applies authenticated request context.

nodes.name: Enforce role
nodes.summary: Guards routes and operations according to the authenticated user role.

nodes.name: Update profile and addresses
nodes.summary: Reads and updates profile, contact, and saved address data.

nodes.name: Onboard Seller
nodes.summary: Submits a seller application and lets an administrator approve or reject marketplace participation.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Seller registration UI and admin seller queue

nodes.name: Submit seller application
nodes.summary: Collects seller registration information for marketplace review.

nodes.name: Review application
nodes.summary: Lists pending seller applications for administrator inspection.

nodes.name: Approve or reject seller
nodes.summary: Records the administrator decision on seller eligibility.

nodes.name: Activate seller capabilities
nodes.summary: Makes the approved seller eligible for seller catalog, order, and wallet operations.

nodes.name: Manage Catalog and Discover Products
nodes.summary: Allows sellers to manage active products while buyers browse, search, filter, and select product variants.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Product, category, and search HTTP endpoints

nodes.name: Maintain product listing
nodes.summary: Creates or edits seller-owned product data and variants.

nodes.name: Publish active product
nodes.summary: Exposes an active seller product to the marketplace catalog.

nodes.name: Search and filter catalog
nodes.summary: Queries products with search terms, facets, and filters.

nodes.name: Select product variant
nodes.summary: Reads product route state to select a product section and SKU variant.

nodes.name: Place Multi-Seller Order
nodes.summary: Merges cart state with checkout details, creates an order, and initializes the selected payment provider.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Checkout submission controller and order endpoint

nodes.name: Review cart items
nodes.summary: Loads cart contents and quantities before checkout submission.

nodes.name: Capture shipping details
nodes.summary: Collects the shipping address and delivery choice for the order.

nodes.name: Create order and sub-orders
nodes.summary: Submits purchased items and checkout data to create the marketplace order structure.

nodes.name: Initialize payment
nodes.summary: Initializes the selected COD or online payment provider and records recovery state when needed.

nodes.name: Fulfill Order
nodes.summary: Moves seller-owned sub-orders through acceptance, rejection, shipping, delivery, and buyer order tracking.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Seller order mutations and order status endpoints

nodes.name: Queue seller order
nodes.summary: Lists pending orders for the responsible seller.

nodes.name: Accept or reject order
nodes.summary: Lets the seller decide whether the sub-order can be fulfilled.

nodes.name: Ship order
nodes.summary: Marks an accepted seller order as shipped through the order API.

nodes.name: Track delivery and completion
nodes.summary: Displays buyer order status as the shipment progresses toward delivery.

nodes.name: Collect and Reconcile Payment
nodes.summary: Confirms payment callbacks or returns, reconciles payment state with the order, and supports provider recovery paths.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Payment provider endpoints and payment return page

nodes.name: Select payment provider
nodes.summary: Presents supported payment methods such as COD, VietQR, Stripe, and PayPal.

nodes.name: Receive provider result
nodes.summary: Reads a payment callback or return result from the selected provider.

nodes.name: Reconcile order status
nodes.summary: Associates provider status with the created order and prevents duplicate submission effects.

nodes.name: Recover pending payment
nodes.summary: Restores interrupted checkout payment state so the buyer can finish or inspect the attempt.

nodes.name: Manage Returns and Reviews
nodes.summary: Creates a return request after an order and captures buyer review feedback for completed commerce.

domainMeta.entryPoint: Return request and review HTTP endpoints

nodes.name: Select return item
nodes.summary: Identifies the sub-order and optional item involved in the return.

nodes.name: Submit return reason and pickup
nodes.summary: Records the reason and pickup or drop-off mode for the return request.

nodes.name: Moderate review
nodes.summary: Places submitted reviews into the administrative moderation queue.

nodes.name: Publish buyer feedback
nodes.summary: Shows approved product reviews and review summaries to marketplace users.

nodes.name: Operate Marketplace
nodes.summary: Gives administrators queues and dashboards for orders, sellers, payouts, disputes, reviews, videos, coupons, and marketplace health.

nodes.name: Inspect marketplace KPIs
nodes.summary: Loads revenue, top products, top sellers, and operational reports.

nodes.name: Review order exceptions
nodes.summary: Filters and inspects administrative order queues and decisions.

nodes.name: Decide payouts and disputes
nodes.summary: Reviews pending seller payouts and open disputes before recording an administrative decision.

nodes.name: Moderate video content
nodes.summary: Processes seller video moderation and appeal queues.

nodes.name: Engage Marketplace Users
nodes.summary: Delivers notifications and supports buyer-seller messaging around marketplace activity.

nodes.name: Publish notification
nodes.summary: Adds a marketplace notification for a user-visible event.

nodes.name: Catch up notifications
nodes.summary: Receives and validates missed notifications after a socket connection is restored.

nodes.name: Open message thread
nodes.summary: Loads or creates a conversation between marketplace participants.

nodes.name: Send message
nodes.summary: Sends a participant message through the messaging channel.

edges.description: Seller identity and approval determine who may manage catalog listings.
Published products and SKU selections become order items.
Order creation initializes payment and fulfillment completion drives settlement.
Order outcomes produce notifications, returns, reviews, and disputes.
Payment and payout exceptions enter administrative operational queues.
